python -c "
import semver

# Test replace function with various scenarios
print('Testing replace function:')

# Basic replacement
result = semver.replace('1.2.3', major=2)
assert result == '2.2.3', f'Expected 2.2.3, got {result}'
print(f'  replace(\"1.2.3\", major=2) = {result!r} ✓')

result = semver.replace('1.2.3', minor=5)
assert result == '1.5.3', f'Expected 1.5.3, got {result}'
print(f'  replace(\"1.2.3\", minor=5) = {result!r} ✓')

result = semver.replace('1.2.3', patch=7)
assert result == '1.2.7', f'Expected 1.2.7, got {result}'
print(f'  replace(\"1.2.3\", patch=7) = {result!r} ✓')

# Replacement with prerelease and build
result = semver.replace('1.2.3-alpha+build', prerelease='beta')
assert result == '1.2.3-beta+build', f'Expected 1.2.3-beta+build, got {result}'
print(f'  replace(\"1.2.3-alpha+build\", prerelease=\"beta\") = {result!r} ✓')

result = semver.replace('1.2.3-alpha+build', build='newbuild')
assert result == '1.2.3-alpha+newbuild', f'Expected 1.2.3-alpha+newbuild, got {result}'
print(f'  replace(\"1.2.3-alpha+build\", build=\"newbuild\") = {result!r} ✓')

# Multiple replacements at once
result = semver.replace('1.2.3-alpha+build', major=3, patch=9, prerelease='rc.1')
assert result == '3.2.9-rc.1+build', f'Expected 3.2.9-rc.1+build, got {result}'
print(f'  replace(\"1.2.3-alpha+build\", major=3, patch=9, prerelease=\"rc.1\") = {result!r} ✓')

# No changes (all None)
result = semver.replace('1.2.3')
assert result == '1.2.3', f'Expected 1.2.3, got {result}'
print(f'  replace(\"1.2.3\") = {result!r} ✓')

# Test VersionInfo.replace method
print('\nTesting VersionInfo.replace method:')

v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build.1')
assert v.major == 1
assert v.minor == 2
assert v.patch == 3
assert v.prerelease == 'alpha'
assert v.build == 'build.1'

# Replace without modifying original
new_v = v.replace(major=2)
assert new_v.major == 2
assert new_v.minor == 2  # unchanged
assert new_v.patch == 3  # unchanged
assert new_v.prerelease == 'alpha'  # unchanged
assert new_v.build == 'build.1'  # unchanged
assert v.major == 1  # original unchanged
print(f'  v.replace(major=2) = {new_v} ✓')
print(f'  Original v unchanged: {v} ✓')

# Replace multiple fields
new_v = v.replace(patch=5, prerelease='beta')
assert new_v.major == 1
assert new_v.minor == 2
assert new_v.patch == 5
assert new_v.prerelease == 'beta'
assert new_v.build == 'build.1'
print(f'  v.replace(patch=5, prerelease=\"beta\") = {new_v} ✓')

# Replace all fields
new_v = v.replace(major=9, minor=8, patch=7, prerelease='final', build='release')
assert str(new_v) == '9.8.7-final+release'
print(f'  v.replace(major=9, minor=8, patch=7, prerelease=\"final\", build=\"release\") = {new_v} ✓')

# Immutability check - __slots__ prevents new attributes
try:
    v.new_attr = 'forbidden'
    assert False, 'Should not be able to set new attributes'
except AttributeError:
    print('  Immutability (__slots__) enforced ✓')

print('\nAll tests passed!')
"
